title:
Custom transform that filters and formats data from {@link ModelScenarioDetailsApplicationState}
to populate the Feature Contributions nested grid on the Model Scenario Details page.

### Expected Payload
```js
{
  "objs": array,
  "alertId": string,
  "fetchSpec": object,
}
```

#### Payload Fields:
- `objs`: An array of alert data objects. Each object is expected to include a `featureContributionMap` property.
- `alertId`: The ID of the alert for which feature contributions are being retrieved. This is used to locate
   the relevant alert object in the `objs` array.
- `fetchSpec`: A {@link UiSdlDefinedValueParam} object defining the base configuration used to build a valid
   `fetchSpec`. This configuration is later applied via {@link ApplyFetchSpecToObjsTransform} to enable
   pagination and filtering.

### Notes
This transform is designed for use within nested grids, which have dynamic IDs.
To ensure correct data mapping, the `fetchSpec.id` is updated to: `${fetchSpec[0].id}_${alertId}`.
This allows the nested grid to render data specific to the alert row that was expanded.
name: ModelScenarioDetailsFeatureContributionsGridDataCollectionTransform
